fields.name: ArgentSea Core
fields.responsibility: Holds the platform-neutral half of ArgentSea: everything that can be expressed without naming SqlClient or Npgsql — how a connection is configured and made resilient, how a query and its parameters are described, how a model is mapped, how a record is identified across shards, and how work is fanned out or batched. These belong together because each is defined purely against the provider seam, and a provider package supplies only the platform-specific end of each.
